title: ACNH 1.0.0 movement, terrain, and story traversal evidence
build_scope: Animal Crossing: New Horizons 1.0.0 reverse engineering only; no Godot or build work

source_identity.note: Existing ADDITIONAL_EXEFS.md records identical main-code segments for the ELF and NSO inputs.

status_legend.EF: EventFlow structure/order and referenced actions; not proof that an action handler's full behavior ran.
status_legend.NATIVE: Bounded execution of original native instructions on reconstructed or synthetic fixture state; not a running game trace.
status_legend.OPEN: Required source or runtime link is unproven.

scope_finding: Bounded native player-position, vertical-motion, ground, terrain-navigation, rectangle, and mutation helpers are documented. Story EventFlows order player-selected construction and later Island Designer unlock. There is no proven live HID-to-position-to-collision-to-player-traversal-to-placement path. Story progression checks placement flags/build counts, but available evidence does not show that crossing a bridge or climbing a ladder is required to advance.

claims: ShopReserveKit previews cMarket with StructureBuildPosType=cPlayer; a static next-day processor checks structure type 0 before the opening/quest announcement flow.
BridgeReserveKit previews cBridge with cPlayer. HousingFinish_Bridge maps selected kit UID 7211 to ImmQ_SetBridge. The quest subsequently grants plot kits 5827-5829 and ladder recipe UID 2615.
MigrateQuestA/B/C preview cReserveNpcHouse with cSettlerQuest and distinguish subjects 0, 1, and 2. Furnishing checks and daily plot completion follow in EventFlow.

Later story gates include constructed-house counts, campsite/first camper, island rating and K.K. first live. Post-concert InvitePlayerHouse sets MainmenuConstructLicense and requests the cConstructLicense application UI.
limits: Flow order and flags do not establish successful live placement, world transform, collision validation, or a physical route.
No EventFlow condition shown requires the player to cross the placed bridge or use the ladder before the plot kits are granted.
Island Designer evidence is an app/UI unlock request, not proof of editor input, preview, validation, mutation, or save behavior.

trace.link: Stored movement components to actor position
claims: Helper 0xdac550 was executed over 3,205 finite reconstructed-state cases on a non-animation branch.

The bounded helper reads player+0xf58 and player+0xf50 as local movement components, yaw-rotates/scales them using context+0xd30, adds XYZ to actor+0x278, writes delta/history fields, and runs original callees without stubs.
limits: Controller/HID sample acquisition and the producer of these player fields are not traced; these are not proven raw stick inputs.
Animation/root-motion branch, gravity integration, collision resolution, full frame scheduler, and timing/units are not covered.

claims: Original fragments of 0xe17cb0 run timing/gravity/ballistic code and store velocity at player+0x574; a separate fragment adds X/Z velocity to actor position.

Eight composed finite cases pass across two selected instruction ranges with a reconstructed gap. Eleven controlled-state fixtures cover selected 0xda86b0 setter branches; twelve 0xdac780 fixtures cover early-return/branch/Y-sink edges.
limits: Time-record/target producers, duration meaning, complete 0xe17cb0 function, state producer 0xdacc40, and frame scheduling are unresolved.
The selected Y sink receives a supplied scalar in its fixture; it does not prove the live collider query supplies a landing value.

trace.link: Collider candidate query to ground result
claims: Static caller shape to 0x7bccf0 is mapped: X0=actor position pointer, X1=null optional output, W2=0, S0=0.0.
The native sandbox attempt did not complete: the world-root slot resolves to null and the code faults at PC 0x172780 while treating low mapped ELF bytes as a grid pointer.
limits: No candidate selection, ground/landing scalar, or live query result was produced.
This reproducible harness-context fault is not a gameplay fault or gameplay behavior claim.

claims: A reconstructed row-major ground grid uses x + width*z indexing and 52-byte runtime records; four tested sector attributes occupy bytes 48-51.
Base/overlay attribute reads, coordinate conversion, and 3 four-point aggregators pass bounded native cases. The tested WaterCheck aggregator uses all four points; PlayerNoEntry uses any point.
limits: The prepared world/grid and ground row caches are reconstructed; active dynamic object-ground overrides are not covered.
These flag aggregators do not cover every walking, burial, water, or collision rule.

claims: Bounded tests cover terrain-height/flag decoding, node callbacks, cost categories, and eight height-to-word-to-node-to-A* chains on reconstructed grids.
Examples demonstrate how tested height differences and flags change directional masks and NPC route costs.
limits: This is NPC pathfinding evidence, not a player traversal or player collider contract.
Only selected surface attributes and finite threshold cases are tested; live terrain edits, original PBC content, and complete player movement are not connected.

trace.link: Region validation/mutation and water/terraform action data
claims: A finite reconstructed-record rectangle predicate, region bit mutators, and a wrapper-to-release-to-rectangle-mutation path have bounded native fixtures.
FieldLandMakingActionParam contains 17 rows. Source rows 9 and 10 specify MakeFall and BreakFall with 3x3 range and layer No0.
limits: The release fixture constructs its owner/list/world records; it is not a capture of a live Island Designer edit.
Field action rows are table configuration. The player action, validation callback, edit transaction, save/undo, and refresh caller are not linked.
The cleanup bit mutation is not evidence that MakeFall/BreakFall runs or succeeds.

trace.link: Island preset loader to runtime collision/ground data
claims: Ninety-six decoded LandMaking presets use 112x96 row-major 14-byte cells with two unit/variation/rotation layers and a height byte.
Static native code maps generator 0x529910 to setup 0x528bf0 and transfer 0x558f40; transfer copies preset fields into destination accessors when required pointers are present.
A separate reconstructed runtime ground record is 52 bytes with height/material fields; its conversion from the 14-byte preset cell is not established.
limits: The generator/setup/resource loader were not executed with live objects; standalone RNG fixture does not reproduce gameplay selection or stream.
Destination allocation/chunk layout, PBC bootstrap, 14-to-52-byte transform, collision mesh, water mesh, and shoreline seam generation remain open.
No PBC-named payload was found in the available partial RomFS or indexed source corpus.

fixture_limits: All native results cited here are bounded helper/fragment executions with reconstructed or synthetic state, not a running ACNH game.
The 0x7bccf0 fault is a null-world-root sandbox limitation and must not be reported as a gameplay fault or result.
No tests, builds, or Godot changes were made for this report; prior fixture outputs were inspected and cited rather than rerun.
The local checkout index.sqlite is empty; prior loader/water reports identify the shared read-only index at /workspace/acnh-re/output/index.sqlite.
